description: This file contains React components and related logic for displaying and managing subscription plans, including plan selection, comparison, testimonials, and footer FAQs for the Notesnook project.

methods.name: PlansList
methods.description: React component for displaying a list of subscription plans with options to select, compare, and view featured endorsements.

methods.name: Footer
methods.description: React component rendering FAQ section and endorsement logos.

methods.name: ComparePlans
methods.description: React component for displaying a comparison table of different subscription plans.

methods.name: formatOneTimePeriod
methods.description: Formats a subscription period into a human-readable string for one-time payments.

methods.name: formatRecurringPeriod
methods.description: Formats a subscription period into a human-readable string for recurring payments.

methods.name: formatRecurringPeriodShort
methods.description: Provides a short abbreviation for recurring periods.

methods.name: getFullPeriod
methods.description: Returns the full name of a period ('month' or 'year').

methods.name: toMonthlyPrice
methods.description: Converts a total price for a given period into a monthly price string.
